prompt: What gear dominates fishing in Taal Lake, and how did its catch per unit effort change?
response: Gill nets are the most dominant gear used in Taal Lake, accounting for approximately 53% of the total gear utilized (Mutia et al., 2018). The catch per unit effort (CPUE) for this gear declined from 11 kg/day to 4 kg/day between 1997 and 2011 (Mutia et al., 2018).
